items.title: Salvage the Clas Ohlson stdlib commit from kuuskaks' old workspace clone

handoff.outcome: Stdlib search change recovered and merged; staged inverse superseded; offline checks and cleanup complete. Live API not exercised. User acceptance remains.

checks.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
paths=set(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','dbf2642de3e145b242bc1cbba8ae8469b23b29ea','d75873d70ac57b440a0b2b21d74fb011a00271e2','--','.',':(exclude)TASKS.md',':(exclude)docs/tasks/33-salvage-the-clas-ohlson-stdlib-commit-from-kuuskaks-old-workspace-clon.md',':(exclude)docs/tasks/33-salvage-the-clas-ohlson-stdlib-commit-from-kuuskaks-old-workspace-clon.evidence.json'],text=True).splitlines())
expected={'clasohlson/SKILL.md','clasohlson/scripts/search.py','clasohlson/tests/test_search.py'}
assert paths == expected, paths
subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check','dbf2642de3e145b242bc1cbba8ae8469b23b29ea','d75873d70ac57b440a0b2b21d74fb011a00271e2'],check=True)
text=Path('docs/tasks/33-salvage-the-clas-ohlson-stdlib-commit-from-kuuskaks-old-workspace-clon.md').read_text()
assert '2f24303308692e717ce99046049198048fb7a6b7' in text and '**Staged change:** superseded' in text
assert not Path('/home/agent/tmp/skills-akaihola-from-kuuskaks-2026-11-01.tar.gz').exists()
assert not Path('/home/agent/tmp/clasohlson-salvage-l5ndgvjl').exists()
print('Reviewed delivery scope, both saved outcomes, whitespace and archive cleanup: OK')
PY
